title: The ELAN data model
summary: European Commission publishes instructions for the ELAN1L-TCDOC data model, which will be mandatory from 17 January 2028
update:
From January 2028, competent authorities in countries exporting agri-food products to the European Union (EU) must issue the following documents electronically through the new Electronic Agricultural Non-customs formalities system ( ELAN ):

documents supporting imports into the EU under tariff rate quotas documents required for exports under sheepmeat and goatmeat tariff quotas authenticity certificates for Basmati rice exports.

These documents must be issued by the relevant competent authorities in the exporting country using the ELAN1L-TCDOC data model either directly in ELAN, or via their own national electronic systems.

The European Commission has published instructions to help authorities use this model.
what_changing:
The European Commission’s new Electronic Agricultural Non-customs formalities system (ELAN) will support the management and storage of the following non-customs documents required in the trade of agri-food products (Regulation 2025/1272 ):

documents supporting imports into the EU under tariff rate quotas (Regulations 2020/761 , Annexes II–XII and 2020/1988 , Annex II) documents required for exports under sheepmeat and goatmeat tariff quotas (Regulation 2020/1988 , Art. 31) authenticity certificates for Basmati rice exports (Regulation 2023/2834 ).

From January 2028 , authorities in the non-EU exporting country must either produce these documents directly in ELAN, or transmit them to ELAN from their own national electronic systems. See ELAN: Electronic system for Agricultural Non-customs formalities .

These documents must be issued by the relevant competent authorities using the ELAN1L-TCDOC data model (Regulation 2020/761 , Annex XIV.8).

To guide competent authorities, the European Commission has published instructions on how to use the ELAN1L-TCDOC data model. The instructions explain the type and format of information required in each column in the model, and clarify which information is mandatory or optional.
why: The EU is moving towards an electronic information exchange system linking all customs authorities and other relevant bodies within and outside the European Union. The new ELAN system will be connected with the EU Single Window Environment for Customs .
timeline: Use of ELAN for these documents is mandatory from 17 January 2028 .
actions:
Exporting countries should ensure that competent authorities are familiar with the ELAN1L-TCDOC template and that national electronic systems are ELAN-compatible ahead of January 2028. Non-EU authorities can already access ELAN to test the issuing and transmitting of documents in an “ELAN acceptance environment”.

To learn more about how ELAN works, see the video and presentation of the AGRINFO’s webinar Introducing the EU’s new Electronic system for Agricultural Non-customs formalities (ELAN) .

summary_fr: La Commission européenne publie des instructions concernant le modèle de données ELAN1L-TCDOC, qui sera obligatoire à partir du 17 janvier 2028
